required_checks.genuine_log_loss: Bernoulli negative-log-likelihood MLE must minimize the sample objective.
required_checks.n_rate: Six-point geometric n sweep spanning at least three orders and 256 deterministic seeds.
required_checks.slope: 95% bootstrap CI contains -0.5 and excludes 0 and -1.
required_checks.quantization_floor: Independent epsilon_q sweep has exponent in [0.99,1.01] and lies below H^2 epsilon_q.
required_checks.finite_policy_class: Actual finite log-loss classes are swept and squared uniform deviation grows linearly with log|Pi| with R^2 >= 0.90.
required_checks.negative_controls: A fixed-sample zero-effect control has slope near 0; an injected wrong-rate control has slope near -1; a one-policy class control removes log|Pi| growth.
required_checks.independent_checker: A second implementation recomputes all decisive fits from raw arrays.

decision: VERIFIED only if every required check and the independent checker pass; otherwise BLOCKED.
